# The Melissa Foundation

> The Melissa Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit charitable organization (EIN 39-4516117), based in Las Vegas, Nevada, that empowers people with knowledge, resources and support to make healthier choices and live healthier lives at every stage of their journey — before, during and after cancer. It is dedicated in loving memory of Jamilla (Elizabeth) Deville.

- Founder: Fawnia. The foundation is dedicated to her best friend Jamilla Deville, a world-renowned pole artist, performer and teacher whose life was forever changed by breast cancer.
- What it does: shares trusted resources and practitioner referrals, hosts community healing events (yoga and sound healing), and creates recipes and educational content on healthy living.
- Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Give via PayPal or Zelle (donate@themelissafoundation.org).
- Contact: donate@themelissafoundation.org · Instagram @themelissafoundation (https://www.instagram.com/themelissafoundation)
- The information on the website is shared for educational purposes only and is not medical advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://themelissafoundation.org/): mission, a message from the founder, and ways to get involved
- [Blog](https://themelissafoundation.org/blog.html): "What is Cancer?" — an introduction to what cancer is and what shapes our health
- [Resources](https://themelissafoundation.org/resources.html): recommended books (Cancer-Free; Chris Beat Cancer; The Alkaline Life) and the Square One healing program; a directory of doctors, naturopaths and practitioners is coming soon
- [Events](https://themelissafoundation.org/events.html): Yoga and Sound Healing with Melissa at Pole Fitness Studio, 4265 S. Arville St., Las Vegas, NV 89103
- [Recipes](https://themelissafoundation.org/recipes.html): juice recipes, starting with the Daily Juice (carrot, beet, celery, ginger)
- [Dedication](https://themelissafoundation.org/dedication.html): in loving memory of Jamilla (Elizabeth) Deville
- [Donate](https://themelissafoundation.org/donate.html): give via PayPal or Zelle; EIN 39-4516117
- [Contact](https://themelissafoundation.org/contact.html): volunteer, partner or sponsor, share a resource, or say hello
